source: SAFFIRE-III sensor workbooks (Calibrated Data), S1C1 and S2C2 JPEG Mapped image sets, PSI-100 CSV, SAFFIRE-I/III DoD
notes: Camera LED strobes every ~2 s before ignition; use ledOn=0 frames for flame detection.
Sample 2 camera shows a flame line on the ignition edge that did not spread; sample thermocouples stayed near 14 C.
Camera 2 for Sample 1 (S1C2) and camera 1 for Sample 2 (S2C1) are not in the archive.
O2/CO2 sensors are in the avionics bay at the inlet (DoD), so gas response is delayed and diluted.
